cases.scope: Build and explicitly deliver the complete lightweight source BIM and viewer from every supplied drawing. First establish the common coordinate frame, major dimensions and supported storey levels/heights from the whole set. Draft each floor early, compare actual-result overlays locally, and fix concrete errors. Complete independent elevation readings and their adopted-value overlay checks. Carry judgments with normal actions, assemble checked floors, and apply supported opening heights in a batch. Review the assembled building for architectural reasonableness and cross-drawing conflicts; reuse unchanged checks and revise only affected scopes. Preserve physical spaces, partitions, openings, hosts and connectivity under the current 0.1 m policy. Save assumptions and unresolved evidence honestly; finish the intended final candidate with finish_bim. Single model, no run-level time deadline; independent quality evaluation follows the run.
